problem: v1.3.0 adds real guided practice, but completion alone does not tell users what they have mastered, what is weak, what should be continued next, or when completed skills should be refreshed.
mastery_contract: exercise completion remains the authoritative source of mastery depth
Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced contribute 20, 35, and 45 mastery points respectively
review history and practice outcomes remain separate from completion so mistakes do not erase earned mastery
started but incomplete labs surface immediately for continued practice
mastered labs enter a local 7, 14, then 30 day review cadence
review verification delegates to the real v1.3.0 Check my work grader
per-lab pass/fail telemetry identifies weak practice without locking navigation
review navigation waits for the intended laboratory practice surface before selecting its level
the review bridge persists across v1.3 practice-panel rerenders and remains attached to the target lab
review verification records one practice outcome per grader execution
progress can be exported as local JSON
review history can be reset without deleting v1.3.0 exercise completion
all labs, free play, demos, guided routes, and v1.3.0 practice remain unlocked
promotion_rule: Promote only after the historical P12/v1.0.1/v1.1.0/v1.2.0 regression workflow, the v1.3.0 learning workflow, and the v1.4.0 mastery workflow all pass on the metadata-complete candidate head.
